claims.text: Equimolar or nearly equimolar CoCrFeNiTi can be in a simple solid-solution state.
The low hardness of simple-solid-solution CoCrFeNiTi is governed by easy dislocation glide.
The low strength of simple-solid-solution CoCrFeNiTi is governed by easy dislocation glide.
The low hardness and strength of simple-solid-solution CoCrFeNiTi are governed by easy dislocation climb.
Equimolar or nearly equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in the specified state lacks significant lattice distortion.
The lack of significant lattice distortion facilitates dislocation glide and climb.
Equimolar or nearly equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in the specified state has a large number of slip systems.
The large number of slip systems facilitates dislocation glide and climb.
Under room-temperature uniaxial tensile loading, simple-solid-solution CoCrFeNiTi has lower hardness than high-entropy alloys with more complex solid-solution states or precipitated phases.
Under room-temperature uniaxial tensile loading, simple-solid-solution CoCrFeNiTi has lower strength than high-entropy alloys with more complex solid-solution states or precipitated phases.
The proposed mechanism is intended to apply to equimolar or nearly equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in a simple solid-solution state under uniaxial tensile loading.
The deformation behavior at high temperatures or under multiaxial loading is not well understood.
